ambiguities.issue: the anatomy fill et is not always 571/601 (A_pm fills at 570 on most days, B600 at 600, and a name can fill later inside a gapped tape)
ambiguities.resolution: entry_et/entry_px are taken verbatim from the anatomy fill (the engine's own source); the ET in the schema text is read as nominal. The realised entry_et distribution is reported under tape_shape.entry_et_histogram.

ambiguities.issue: ambiguous between the day-level close (959/779) and the member's own last bar (a halted name may stop printing before the close)
ambiguities.resolution: session_end is the day-level close from phase2_session_calendar.json, repeated on every row; the member's actual tape end is exposed as the producer addition member_last_et. Members whose tape ends before the close are counted under tape_shape.members_without_final_bar.
ambiguities.schema: `session_end` | ET of the last bar used for this day

ambiguities.issue: no definition of the reference prices; bars are per-day only
ambiguities.resolution: the anatomy name fields `prev_close` and `open0930` are used (canonical day constants; open0930 equals the 09:30 bar open). Both are repeated per row as producer additions so the reference is auditable.

ambiguities.issue: clock minutes vs bar count, and whether the bar at t counts
ambiguities.resolution: clock minutes: bars with et in (t-k, t] that set a new running high since the fill (strictly above the running high). The fill bar counts as setting the running high.
ambiguities.schema: `new_high_count_5/15/30` (bars in the last 5/15/30 minutes that set a new high)

ambiguities.issue: whether the re-evaluated running high starts at t or from the fill
ambiguities.resolution: the running high is the same object as the state column: max high from the fill through the bar being tested. Exit is the open of the bar after the first close <= running_high * (1 - g/100); when the trigger is the last bar, or when it never triggers, the exit is the forced flat close of the member's last bar (giveback_fired_* records whether it fired).
ambiguities.schema: `v_giveback_5/10/15/20` ('the running high as of that bar')

ambiguities.issue: the threshold is a computed product (running_high * (1 - g/100)), so a close exactly g% below the running high can fall on either side of the comparison because of binary rounding
ambiguities.resolution: a drop of exactly g% is a hit: the comparison carries a 1e-9 relative tolerance on the running high (far below any economically meaningful difference; the alternative is a float artifact deciding the exit).

ambiguities.issue: interacts with check (e): every outcome column null iff next_open is null
ambiguities.resolution: v_sell is 0.0 whenever next_open exists and null on the member's last bar, so the null rule holds literally.

ambiguities.issue: these are the only outcome columns defined null when an event never occurs
ambiguities.resolution: kept as null-with-event semantics; the self-test enforces nullness whenever next_open is null for every outcome column, and enforces non-null only for the event-defined columns other than these two.

ambiguities.issue: stated for both families although B600 entries come from the `B` T=600 snapshot
ambiguities.resolution: implemented literally: the cross-section universe is the day's A_pm snapshot for A_pm and B600 rows alike. `peer_*` use the member's own family.
share of the universe names with a bar at t and a defined 09:30 return whose return is <= the member's return, in [0, 1].

ambiguities.issue: count of peers vs count of new-high bars
ambiguities.resolution: count of distinct peer members with at least one new-high bar in (t-5, t].
ambiguities.schema: `peer_new_high_5` ('how many of those others set a new high')

ambiguities.issue: what 'the most recent episode' means when the member is currently below entry
ambiguities.resolution: episode = maximal run of completed closes < entry; while the run is open its own running low is used, otherwise the low of the last closed run. bars_since_episode_low counts bars from the bar that set that low.

ambiguities.issue: whether 'prior bars' may reach back before the fill
ambiguities.resolution: yes: they use the member's bars with et <= t, including bars before the fill (those bars are known at t, so causality holds); null when the history does not exist. The attention columns follow their 'since entry' wording and are clamped at the fill bar.

ambiguities.issue: median window and whether the value is a ratio or a return
ambiguities.resolution: ratio; denominator = median of bar volumes from the fill through t inclusive; null until 5 prior bars exist since the fill.

ambiguities.issue: positions with fewer than 10 bars since the fill
ambiguities.resolution: null until 10 bars since the fill exist; both windows are positional and clamped at the fill.
ambiguities.schema: `volume_accel` (mean volume of the last 5 bars / mean of the prior 5 - 1)

ambiguities.resolution: index differences: the bar immediately after t is 1; the fill bar is 0. Ties on the maximum high resolve to the first (earliest) bar.

ambiguities.issue: they are session-wide, i.e. look-ahead relative to a row at t < peak
ambiguities.resolution: kept as documented ticket constants for the fall analysis; they are not state and must not be used as causal features. They are non-null on every row including the member's last bar (they are not outcome columns).

ambiguities.issue: bar dollar volume has no exact definition from OHLCV bars

conventions.causality: state uses only bars with et <= t plus the fill; no session aggregate after t
conventions.execution: a decision at completed bar t executes at the open of bar t+1
conventions.fill_bar: first bar of the member with et >= the anatomy fill et
conventions.friction: none in the panel; analyses apply bps_total/2 per side on the executed action
conventions.last_bar: at the member's last tracked bar, next_open/next_et and every outcome column are null
conventions.member_window: fill bar .. last member bar with et <= session_end (see member_last_et)
conventions.no_fabrication: a missing input yields null, never a filled or carried value
conventions.session_end: day-level session end (959, or 779 on the 7 half-days), repeated per row
conventions.sort: rows sorted by (sleeve_day, family, entry_rank, et)

producer_additions.bar_close: raw tape: close of the completed bar t (= the panel's mark price)
producer_additions.bar_high: raw tape: high of the completed bar t
producer_additions.bar_low: raw tape: low of the completed bar t
producer_additions.bar_open: raw tape: open of the completed bar t (causal; = next_open of row t-1)
producer_additions.member_last_et: ET of the last bar of this member's tracked window; equals session_end when the member traded into the close
producer_additions.open0930: anatomy day constant, used by ret_from_open0930 (repeated per row)
producer_additions.prev_close: anatomy day constant, used by ret_from_prevclose (repeated per row)
